title: The tech's fall
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Wednesday. The tech has a count on the wall too, Wood sees for the first time: pencil marks, in fives, under the machine's serial number. Digests. Fifty-two and one gap. The gap is March. The tech says the machine keeps track. The machine doesn't. He does.

panels.composition: The print shop. WOOD noticing, on the wall beside the copier, pencil tallies in fives under a serial number as blocks. The TECH. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a young man noticing pencil tally marks on a print shop wall beneath a copier's serial plate while a technician works, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The tallies: fifty-two. And one space with no mark. March.

image.prompt: close on pencil tally marks in groups of five on a wall with one small gap in the sequence, black and white, no words
a print technician, dry, not looking up, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood looking at the gap. March. The pulled strip's week. The tech counted the gap too. Two walls with tallies now; the strip's count is kept in two places it didn't ask for.

image.prompt: a young man looking at a gap in tally marks on a wall while a technician's back is turned, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: The tech's tally. Fifty-two and the gap. Two walls keep the count.
